title: Juniper and the Letter
author: Coral Montrose
blurb: Wren Nakamura, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
